title: ask-command-cheatsheet
desc: wkappbot ask command cheatsheet: claude/gpt/gemini/triad dispatch, CDP port isolation, cdp field in grap, eval replacement with --eval-js.
steps: ask triad 'question' -- dispatch to AI tab via CDP. Each runs against the project's Chrome (cdp={port} profile)
CDP isolation: each project has own Chrome in chrome-profiles/cdp={port}/. Ask NEVER touches another project's Chrome
cdp open URL -> returns OK {proc:'chrome',...,cdp:9222}. Use this grap for subsequent a11y commands to pin port
a11y eval REMOVED -- use a11y read/find/click with --eval-js 'expr' instead
a11y find '{proc:chrome,cdp:9222}' -- only finds Chrome on port 9222, personal Chrome excluded
author: claude
